note: Configurable SYNTHETIC clarifications for the BR-101 demo. Example demo rules only — not L'Oréal standards or scientifically established thresholds.

correct_match.answer: Primary metric: top-1 shade accuracy against the reference shade ID. Secondary: top-3 accuracy. Abstentions count as incorrect.

group_definitions.answer: Use the four synthetic tone strata TS-1..TS-4 from grouping protocol GP-DEMO-1. 'Deeper skin tones' = TS-4. Target cell: TS-4 × warm_indoor.

lighting_protocol.answer: Use the three declared lighting categories of SPEC-LIGHT-003 §1, captured per §2 with a grey reference card.

reference_labels.answer: Reference shade IDs from label protocol LP-DEMO-PANEL-01 (synthetic). Label validity still requires expert review.

acceptable_regression.answer: No required cell may lose more than 2 percentage points of top-1 accuracy against baseline; the target cell must improve by at least 5 percentage points.

supported_devices.answer: Validated devices: DEV-T1 and DEV-T2. DEV-T3 is not validated and must be watched in monitoring.

recapture.answer: Request another image when SPEC-IQ-002 §2 triggers fire; count such requests as abstentions.

release_evidence.answer: Minimum 100 eligible samples per required cell; all privacy and authorization control tests must pass; evaluation must be current and digest-matched.
